span.p:
MiniGameMenu
UIDocument + Systems_MiniGameMenu
builds the whole UI in code — no UXML

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
SO_MiniGameSelection
ScriptableObject — the ONLY cross-scene state
project rule: no singletons, no DontDestroyOnLoad

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Always active
Ground · BoxingRing · RingRopes · Arena (396 objects)
StadiumLights · PostVolume · HudChrome · Main Camera

span.p:
ContestSpawner + MiniGameLauncher
adopts the contestants placed in the scene

WinnerBanner · HazardDirector · RoundCountdown
KnockoutFx · FallImpactFx · CrowdAudio · MatchDirector

span.p:
Always active
Ground · StartLine · FinishLine
HudChrome · Main Camera + RaceCamera

span.p:
MiniGameLauncher + ContestSpawner
one lane per contestant

div.style: color: rgb(122, 130, 140) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ContestSystems — starts INACTIVE
WalkContest referee · Announcer · CrowdAudio
RoundCountdown · WinnerBanner · MatchDirector · FallImpactFx

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Systems_ContestSpawner.SpawnAndBegin(int[])
1 — adopt each picked contestant standing in the scene
2 — stand down the ones the menu left out
3 — (roster prefabs only) build under an INACTIVE holder, Configure(), reparent
4 — wake ContestSystems, hand over to the referee

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Nick is a MuJoCo creature
refereed through IContestFighter from another assembly
so PoBox.Runtime never links the MuJoCo plugin.
Both scenes load nick_balance_002.onnx at 0.02 s.
